title: Army custodial PWS package: Attachment J-0001 TE-1 facility list (26 bldgs, zone subtotals, landscape PDF) + SF 30 Amendment 0002 (3 GSF corrections Was/Is, 2 buildings added, Bldg 118 deleted, revised totals) + Questions and Answers No. 1 (docx: incumbent, contract number, FY2025 obligations, Bldg 1207 floor-count correction)

sources.note: USDA AMS SF-30 amendment: "The purpose of this amendment is to make changes to the solicitation as follows" followed by numbered section-by-section changes ("... is changed to the following"). Model for the Block 14 purpose sentence and the FROM/TO change paragraphs.

DOE custodial services (Forrestal / Germantown) SF-30 amendment: "Attachment 2-PWS is deleted in its entirety and the revised Attachment 2 is substituted in lieu thereof." Model for the "deleted ... in its entirety" wording used for Building 118.

Army solicitation amendment (SF 30, "AMENDMENT OF SOLICITATION/MODIFICATION OF CONTRACT") revising Technical Exhibits with the standard Block 14 sentence "Except as provided herein, all terms and conditions of the document referenced in Item 9A or 10A, as heretofore changed, remains unchanged and in full force and effect." Copied into Block 14.
RFP Amendment 0003 on the SF 30: Technical Exhibit 8 of the PWS "amended as set forth in Item 14". Model for amending a PWS technical exhibit through Block 14 continuation pages.

Signed SF30 for a custodial-scope solicitation: "The purpose of this amendment is to: 1- correct the language in SOW/4-Deliverables ..." with numbered changes and an attached Q&A. Model for the numbered purpose list (a/b/c) and issuing the Q&A with the amendment.

Federal Responses to Questions: "Who is the current incumbent, contract number, and how long have..." answered with the incumbent and contract number, while "the Government elects not to disclose the length of the contract nor the contract value". Model for Q1/Q2 wording ("The Government elects not to disclose the incumbent's staffing").

NATO custodial services IFIB Q&A 2: "Will the Government please provide the incumbent name and incumbent contract number?" answered with contract reference and company name. Model for the incumbent answer format.

NYS OGS bidder Q&A laid out as a table (Question # / Solicitation Document Name / Document Section / Question / answer). Model for the No. / Solicitation Reference / Question / Government Response table in the docx.
SWACO custodial RFP Addendum 1 answering the incumbent question with the firm name and the current contract value for a multi-year period. Model for answering incumbent and value in one response.
Fort Sill custodial solicitation Q&A of 75 contractor questions on the PWS and Technical Exhibits. Model for grouping questions by PWS / Technical Exhibit reference.

provenance.notes: Layout and wording follow real SF 30 amendments and solicitation Q&A documents found in search excerpts (the documents themselves could not be downloaded). No facility rows are copied: Fort Calder, the solicitation and contract numbers, the incumbent, the contracting officer, every building, square footage, floor count, frequency and dollar value are illustrative. SF 30 block labels and the Block 11 acknowledgment paragraph follow the standard form (Rev. 11/2016).

traps: Three documents must be merged in precedence order: base TE-1 (PDF) -> Amendment 0002 (SF 30 PDF) -> Questions and Answers No. 1 (DOCX). Truth is the post-amendment, post-Q&A list of 27 facilities totaling 627,675 GSF.

Amendment 0002 paragraph 3.1 prints both the old and the new GSF in Was / Is Changed To columns (multi-row header): Bldg 104 18,240 -> 19,860, Bldg 1210 31,640 -> 33,120, Bldg 2101 54,780 -> 52,980 (a decrease). Take the "Is Changed To" value; the base TE-1 values are superseded.

Building 118 (7,920 GSF, Weekly) is in the base TE-1 table with full data but "is deleted from the requirement in its entirety" by Amendment 0002 paragraph 3.2 (Item 7 reserved, items not renumbered). It must be excluded; the Q&A (Question 5) repeats the deletion.

Two facilities exist only in the amendment (paragraph 3.3, TE-1 items 27 and 28): Bldg 1218 Battalion Headquarters, 3rd Battalion (2 floors, 23,700 GSF, Daily M-F) and Bldg 2145 Soldier Readiness Processing (SRP) Center (1 floor, 17,385 GSF, Daily M-F).

Floor count for Bldg 1207 is corrected only in the Q&A (Question 6): TE-1 says 1 floor, the response says "corrected from 1 to 2" and GSF 14,880 is unchanged. The question text itself restates the wrong value.

Q&A Question 4 quotes the superseded Bldg 2101 figure (54,780 GSF) in the question; the answer points to the amendment value 52,980. Q&A Question 10 and 11 restate unchanged GSF (11,960 and 44,300); they are not new facilities.

Totals and subtotals are not facilities: base TE-1 has three "Zone N Subtotal" rows and a "TOTAL - TE-1 (26 FACILITIES) 593,210" row; Amendment 0002 paragraph 3.4 has a Was/Is totals table (191,140 / 184,840; 160,355 / 185,535; 241,715 / 257,300; 593,210 / 627,675) and paragraph 2 restates the PWS 1.3 total FROM 593,210 TO 627,675.

Distractor buildings that are not in scope: Bldg 131 (Vehicle Storage, 6,400 SF in Q&A Question 7) and Bldg 2150 (Thrift Shop, TE-1 note a). Bldg 1220 footnote 2 mentions maintenance bays of approximately 64,200 SF that are excluded; GSF stays 11,960.
Bldgs 1203 and 1205 have identical GSF (22,150) and nearly identical names; both are real line items, not duplicates. Bldg 1218 (3rd Battalion) is a third similar name added by amendment.

Superscript footnote markers sit directly after building numbers in TE-1 (118³, 1220², 2101⁴, 2124⁵) and after the GSF column header; in the pdftotext layer they glue onto the number ("1183", "21014", "21245"; on the wrapped 1220 row the ² drops to its own line). The building numbers are 118, 1220, 2101 and 2124.

TE-1 spans two landscape pages with a repeated two-row grouped header (Facility / Workload / Service) and dark zone banner rows; pages 1-2 of the PWS are portrait text with a period-of-performance table and a frequency-definition table (not facilities).

Service frequency is spelled out per row: "Daily (M-F)" = daily_5, "Daily (7 Days)" = daily_7, "3x Weekly", "2x Weekly", "Weekly"; PWS 5.1 defines them in a table. Bldg 2101 service hours "0400-0530 and 1300-1500" and remarks such as "Locker rooms 2x daily" must not change the frequency.

Prior award comes only from the Q&A (Question 1): incumbent Ostrander Facility Group, LLC, contract W9124D-21-C-0007 awarded 24 September 2021, "Total obligations for FY2025 were $4,812,330 (1 October 2024 through 30 September 2025)" = spendToDate 4,812,330 over 12 months. No total contract value is given. Question 3 states $186,415 of over-and-above work orders that is already included in, not in addition to, the FY2025 obligations.
Contract term: 12-month base + four 12-month options = 5 contract years; the FAR 52.217-8 six-month extension and the 30-day phase-in are not additional contract years.

Package also states other dates and numbers that are not workload: proposal due date extended from 30 June 2026 to 10 July 2026, requisition number 0011837245, FY2026 demolition program, beneficial occupancy date 1 August 2026.
